run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
create_GTNLossFunction: create a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence alignment loss computation
build_make_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
review_forward_backward: review the forward and backward methods of GTNLossFunction that use gtn.parallel_for for batched graph scoring
test_GTNLoss_main: test the GTNLoss end-to-end by running main to compute loss and gradients on random batched inputs
